title: Numbers and variables
summary: Names, ints that never overflow, floats, the three kinds of division, and f-string formatting.
hints: `split_bill`: `divmod(a, b)` returns the pair `(a // b, a % b)` in one go, which is exactly (share, leftover). `average` must use true division `/`, which always returns a float, even for `6 / 3`.

`fahrenheit_label`: the conversion is `c * 9 / 5 + 32`. A format spec rounds for you: `f"{value:.1f}"` shows one decimal. `digit_sum`: `abs(n)` first, then either loop with `n % 10` and `n //= 10`, or turn it into a string and add up `int(ch)` for each character.

`format_money`: split into dollars and cents with `divmod(abs(cents), 100)`, then `f"{dollars:,}.{rest:02d}"`: `,` adds thousands separators and `02d` pads the cents to two digits. Put `-` in front when the original amount was negative.
